tiers.title: Tiers
tiers.empty.heading: Create your first tier
tiers.empty.body: A tier is a wholesale price level, such as Retailer or Distributor. Approved buyers see the prices of their tier.
tiers.budget: {used} of {limit} B2B catalogs used. Shopify counts catalogs made outside Tradepass too.
tiers.block.catalog_limit: All {limit} B2B catalogs on your Shopify plan are in use ({used} of {limit}). Delete a catalog, or link an existing catalog to a new tier.
tiers.block.no_b2b: B2B isn't available on your Shopify plan, so tiers can't be created.
tiers.block.markets_unavailable: B2B catalogs need the new Shopify Markets. Turn it on in Shopify settings, then come back.
tiers.col.name: Tier
tiers.assisted.heading: {count, plural, one {# tier assignment needs your action} other {# tier assignments need your action}}
tiers.assisted.body: Open the market in Shopify, add or remove the company location, then press Check. We confirm it by reading the market back.
tiers.assisted.notYet: Not done yet in Shopify. Make the change there, then check again.
tiers.editor.section.name: Name
tiers.editor.name: Tier name
tiers.editor.nameHelp: Only you see this name, for example Retailer or Distributor.
tiers.editor.buyerNamesHelp: Optional. Shown to buyers in emails and on your store, per language. Empty uses the tier name.
tiers.editor.pctHelp: Between 1 and 90 percent off your retail prices.
tiers.editor.catalogHelp: Linking a catalog you already have doesn't use another catalog slot.
tiers.editor.direct: Assign the catalog directly to company locations
tiers.editor.directHelp: Available on Shopify Plus. No B2B market is created and there's no catalog limit.
tiers.editor.collectionsHelp: Products added to these collections later are added when you save the tier again.
tiers.editor.checkout.draft: Orders come to you for review as drafts
tiers.editor.tax.exempt: Exempt when a valid certificate or VAT number is on file
tiers.editor.quantityRules: Minimums and quantity rules are set in Shopify's catalog settings.
tiers.editor.fixErrors: Fix the highlighted fields to save this tier.
tiers.editor.error.pctRange: Enter a whole number from 1 to 90.
tiers.delete.heading: Delete {name}?
tiers.delete.blocked: {count, plural, one {# buyer is still in this tier. Move them to another tier first.} other {# buyers are still in this tier. Move them to another tier first.}}
tiers.delete.body: The tier is removed from Tradepass. Applications suggesting it will have no suggested tier.
tiers.delete.shopify: Also delete the B2B market, catalog and price list Tradepass created in Shopify
tiers.delete.shopifyHelp: Leave this off to keep them in Shopify and manage them yourself.
tiers.delete.notOurs: The market and catalog weren't created by Tradepass, so they stay in Shopify.
tiers.error.plan_limit: The Free plan includes 1 tier. Upgrade to create more.
tiers.error.catalog_limit: Your Shopify plan's B2B catalog limit is reached. Delete a catalog in Shopify or link an existing one.
tiers.error.no_b2b: B2B isn't available on this store's Shopify plan.
tiers.error.markets_unavailable: B2B catalogs need the new Shopify Markets turned on.
tiers.error.volume_pricing: This catalog uses volume pricing or quantity rules, which can't be used in a B2B market here.
tiers.error.catalog_in_use: Another tier already uses this catalog or its market.
tiers.error.has_buyers: Move this tier's buyers to another tier before deleting it.
tiers.error.missing_in_shopify: The catalog was deleted in Shopify.
tiers.error.verify_failed: Shopify didn't confirm the change. Try again.
tiers.error.concurrent: The market was changed at the same time. Try again.
tiers.error.busy: Another change to tiers is running. Try again in a moment.
